name: burythehammer-claude-code-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins for development workflows

plugins.name: terraform-migration
plugins.description: Skills for migrating any Terraform provider from SDK v2 to the Plugin Framework. Step-by-step workflow, code patterns, schema mapping, and common gotchas.

plugins.name: repo-wiki
plugins.description: Skills for maintaining structured per-project wikis in Outline. Supports init, sync, lint, enrich, and search commands.

plugins.name: claude-md-slim
plugins.description: Audit bloated CLAUDE.md files and restructure them with progressive disclosure. Deletes common-knowledge rules, extracts sections into path-scoped .claude/rules/ files and subdirectory CLAUDE.md files, injects @imports, and offloads long-form docs to Outline when configured.

plugins.name: hemingway
plugins.description: Rigorous copy-editing skill inspired by Hemingway's principles. Flags passive voice, adverbs, jargon, and AI slop, with specialized modes for marketing copy, technical specs, technical blogs, and SEO content.
